sentences.text: Nishant Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 19 October, 2023

Author: A. Abhishek Reddy
Bench: A. Abhishek Reddy
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Patna
 Civil Writ Jurisdiction Case No.15065 of 2023
 ======================================================
 Nishant Kumar S/o Late Basudeo Banka Resident of Ujiarpur, P.S.- Ujiarp
 District- Samastipur, Proprietor of M/s Basudeo Rice Mill Ujiarpur,
 Samastipur.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
... ... Petition
 Versus
 1. The State of Bihar through the Secretary, Food and Consumer Protection
 Department, Government of Bihar, Patna.
 2. The Collector, Samastipur.
3. The Block Supply Officer, Ujiarpur, Samastipur.

=
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. N.K. Agrawal, Sr. Adv.
 : Mr. Dhananjaya Nath Tiwari, Adv.
 : Mr. Kumar Rajdeep, Adv.
 For the Respondent/s : Mr. Maruth Nath Roy AC to SC4  : Mr. Arvind Ujjwal, Adv.

======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE A. ABHISHEK REDDY  ORAL ORDER 2 19-10-2023 Heard the learned counsels for the parties.

The present writ petition has been filed for the following relief(s):-
"1.

That this writ application is being filed on behalf of the petitioner for issuance of a writ in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondents and/or direction to release 311.60 quintals of rice and 12.5 kg of wheat seized in connection with Ujiarpur P.S. Case No. 379/2023 under section 7 of the E.C. Act and 420/467/468//34 of the IPC to the satisfaction of the Learned S.D.J.M. Dalsingsarai District Samastipur on furnishing sufficient sureties and/or such term/s as this Hon'ble Court deems fit and proper subject to result of criminal case and confiscation case if any."

2. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the Patna High Court CWJC No.15065 of 2023(2)
dt.19-10-2023 petitioner has stated that under similar circumstances, this Court in CWJC No. 697 of Nishant Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3361321/
1 2022 dated 07.07.2022 and CWJC No. 7145 of 2023 dated 22.06.2023 has directed the concerned District Magistrate to release the food grains and also the vehicle that was seized from the petitioner therein.

entities.text: CWJC No. 697 of Nishant Kumar vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner has stated that the petitioner is similarly situated and that the petitioner is ready to furnish adequate security/surety for the purpose of release of food grains as per the direction of the District Magistrate, Samastipur.

Further, it is submitted that the confiscation proceedings are in the nature of civil proceedings and it is ultimately the sale proceeds of the confiscated property that will go into the account of the State and the petitioner is ready and willing to provide adequate securities/sureties.
Therefore, the District Magistrate, Samastipur may be directed to release the food grains in favor of the petitioner, subject to any other condition that may be imposed.

3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the respondents has stated that as the petitioner is ready to provide adequate securities/sureties and to abide by the reasonable terms and conditions that may be imposed by the District Magistrate, Samastipur, he has no objection if this Hon'ble Court directs the Patna High Court CWJC No.15065 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 District Magistrate,
Samastipur, to release the food grains in favor of the petitioner subject to the petitioner providing adequate securities/sureties to the extent of the value of the food grains and also subject to the petitioner abiding by other terms and conditions that may be imposed by the District Magistrate,
Samastipur.

4. Having regard to the above facts and circumstances of the case and also the judgments of this Hon'ble Court referred above, this Court directs the District Magistrate, Samastipur, to release the food grains seized from the petitioner in connection with Ujiarpur P.S. Case No. 379 of 2023, which are subject matter of the present writ petition, subject to the condition that the petitioner shall make available adequate and sufficient securities/sureties (not in cash or bank guarantee) to the satisfaction of the District Magistrate, Samastipur, to the extent of the value of the food grains which may be assessed and that the petitioner undertakes to abide by any other condition that may be imposed for the purpose of future proceedings by the District Magistrate, Samastipur.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner undertakes on instruction from the petitioner that if the food grains are released in his favor, in course of trial he will not raise any question with Patna High Court CWJC No.15065 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 respect to the seizure of the food grains and no identification.
issue shall be raised in course of trial.

Further, the photographs of the jute/plastic bags containing the rice which may be exhibited in course of trial and the samples of the seized food grains if obtained in accordance with law shall not be questioned by the petitioner and he will not claim any benefit out of this order in the pending proceedings and pursuant to the release of the food grains in his favor.
6. Let the District Magistrate, Samastipur, pass an appropriate order after valuation of the food grains and other conditions to which the petitioner would be required to abide by.
Such orders be passed within two weeks from the date of receipt/communication of this order.
7. With the above directions, the present Writ Petition is allowed to the extent indicated.
